description: Last Logged Production Hardening - Security, reliability, UX, and App Store compliance fixes identified during production readiness review

userStories.title: Secure credential injection with build-time configuration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need API keys injected via XCConfig files and build phases so that placeholder keys are never shipped and credentials stay out of source control.
acceptanceCriteria: XCConfig files created for Debug and Release configurations with placeholders for SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_ANON_KEY, REVENUECAT_API_KEY, TELEMETRYDECK_APP_ID
XCConfig files added to .gitignore with a .xcconfig.example template checked in
Info.plist reads API keys from build settings ($(SUPABASE_URL), etc.)
SupabaseService.swift reads URL and key from Bundle.main.infoDictionary instead of hardcoded strings
RevenueCatService.swift reads API key from Bundle.main.infoDictionary instead of hardcoded string
AnalyticsService.swift reads app ID from Bundle.main.infoDictionary instead of hardcoded string
App crashes with a clear fatalError message at launch if any required key is missing or still a placeholder
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Implemented via AppSecrets.swift pattern — services read from centralized enum, validate() crashes release builds with placeholders.

userStories.title: SwiftData migration plan for future schema changes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a versioned SwiftData migration plan so that app updates don't crash users on older database schemas.
acceptanceCriteria: VersionedSchema defined for current schema as SchemaV1 with all three models (TrackerItem, CompletionLog, TrackerCategory)
SchemaMigrationPlan created with a stage array (initially empty, ready for future migrations)
ModelContainer initialized with migrationPlan parameter in LastLoggedApp.swift
Widget extension ModelContainer also uses the migration plan
CLAUDE.md updated with instructions for adding future migrations
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: SchemaVersions.swift in Models/ with SchemaV1 + LastLoggedMigrationPlan. Both app and widget targets use versioned schema.

userStories.title: Data sync retry logic and offline queue
userStories.description: As a user, I want my data changes to be reliably synced even when my network is unreliable, so I never lose tracked data.
acceptanceCriteria: SupabaseService maintains a persistent sync queue (stored in UserDefaults or a lightweight file) of pending operations
Failed sync operations are retried with exponential backoff (2s, 4s, 8s, 16s) up to 4 attempts
Sync errors are logged to AnalyticsService with context (push/pull, table, error type)
Network reachability monitored via NWPathMonitor — sync triggers automatically when connectivity returns
Debounced sync no longer cancels previous pending operations — only delays the trigger
SyncStatus on TrackerItems correctly reflects actual server state (not optimistically set to .synced before confirmation)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Added NWPathMonitor, retry with backoff, persistent pending flag, error logging on all push/pull ops.

userStories.title: ModelContext thread safety fixes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need all SwiftData ModelContext access to happen on the main actor so that background task access doesn't cause crashes.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeViewModel.scheduleNotifications() wraps the Task in @MainActor
NotificationService.rescheduleAllNotifications uses @MainActor for all modelContext access
SupabaseService sync methods access modelContext only on @MainActor
All ViewModels that pass modelContext to async operations use @MainActor isolation
No modelContext access occurs off the main thread
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: All Task blocks with modelContext access now use @MainActor. NotificationService.rescheduleAll marked @MainActor.

userStories.title: Strengthen password validation and add auth rate limiting
userStories.description: As a user, I want strong password requirements and protection against brute-force attacks so my account stays secure.
acceptanceCriteria: Password minimum length increased to 8 characters
Password must contain at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, and one number
Inline validation messages shown below the password field as the user types
After 5 failed sign-in attempts, a 30-second cooldown is enforced with countdown timer
AuthViewModel tracks failed attempt count and cooldown expiry in-memory
Cooldown resets after successful sign in
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current 6-char minimum with no complexity is too weak. No brute-force protection exists.

userStories.title: Widget premium tier enforcement
userStories.description: As a developer, I need widgets to respect free tier limits so that non-paying users don't get premium widget features for free.
acceptanceCriteria: WidgetDataProvider checks RevenueCat entitlement status via App Group shared UserDefaults
RevenueCatService writes isPremium boolean to App Group UserDefaults on every tier change
Free tier widgets limited to small size only — medium and large show upgrade prompt
Free tier widget shows max 1 overdue item (matches FreeTierLimits.maxWidgetStyles = 1)
Premium users see full widget functionality across all sizes
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Widgets currently ignore subscription status entirely.

userStories.title: Add loading states to all async UI actions
userStories.description: As a user, I want to see loading indicators when actions are processing so the app feels responsive and I know my tap registered.
acceptanceCriteria: Log button in TrackerRowView shows a brief spinner or animation during logCompletion execution
SettingsView export data action shows a ProgressView while generating export
SettingsView clear data action shows a ProgressView during deletion
AuthView sign-in and sign-up buttons show ProgressView while authenticating
TrackerDetailView shows a loading state while fetchCompletionLogs is executing
All loading states disable the triggering button to prevent double-taps
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Several async actions have no visual feedback. Users may double-tap thinking nothing happened.

userStories.title: Website security headers and placeholder link fixes
userStories.description: As a developer, I need CSP headers, proper external link attributes, and real App Store links on the website for security and functionality.
acceptanceCriteria: Content-Security-Policy header configured via Cloudflare _headers file or Astro integration
All external links have rel='noopener noreferrer' attribute
App Store badge href updated from '#' to actual App Store URL (or a redirect page if not yet published)
404.astro error page created with navigation back to home
X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff header added
X-Frame-Options: DENY header added
Typecheck passes
Verify in browser using dev-browser skill
userStories.notes: Missing CSP headers, broken App Store link, no 404 page.

userStories.title: Database audit log table and soft delete for completion logs
userStories.description: As a developer, I need an audit trail and soft deletion so that data loss is recoverable and we have compliance-ready logging.
acceptanceCriteria: New SQL migration adds audit_log table with: id, user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, metadata (JSONB), created_at
RLS policy on audit_log: users can only read their own entries
deleted_at TIMESTAMPTZ column added to completion_logs table
RLS policies on completion_logs updated to filter WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
Index added on completion_logs(deleted_at) for efficient filtering
Edge function export-data endpoint filters out soft-deleted logs
Migration is self-contained and idempotent (uses IF NOT EXISTS)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Currently cascade-deleting a tracker item permanently destroys all completion history.

userStories.title: Onboarding paywall presented as optional suggestion
userStories.description: As a new user, I want the post-onboarding paywall to be a gentle suggestion rather than a mandatory gate so I can explore the app before deciding to upgrade.
acceptanceCriteria: OnboardingView presents PaywallView with isHardPaywall=false (soft paywall) after onboarding completion
Paywall sheet is dismissible via close button and swipe-to-dismiss
User can skip the paywall and proceed to the main app immediately
Analytics event tracked for paywall_dismissed vs paywall_converted
AnalyticsService gains trackPaywallDismissed() method
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current forced paywall after onboarding creates poor first impression and risks App Store rejection.

userStories.title: Edge function APNs key from environment variable
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the APNs authentication key loaded from an environment variable instead of filesystem so deployment is more secure.
acceptanceCriteria: apns.ts supports APNS_KEY_CONTENT env var containing the base64-encoded .p8 key content
When APNS_KEY_CONTENT is set, key is decoded and passed directly to apn.Provider (no filesystem read)
Falls back to APNS_KEY_PATH file read if APNS_KEY_CONTENT is not set
.env.example updated with APNS_KEY_CONTENT documentation
Dockerfile updated to not require mounted certificate volume when using APNS_KEY_CONTENT
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Storing certificates on the filesystem is less secure than environment-based injection.

userStories.title: Edge function structured logging with request correlation
userStories.description: As a developer, I need structured JSON logging with request IDs across all edge function endpoints for production debugging.
acceptanceCriteria: All console.log/error calls in export-data.ts, revenuecat-webhook.ts, and reminder-digest.ts use structured JSON format
Each log entry includes: timestamp, requestId (from middleware), event type, and relevant context
Failed webhook signature attempts logged with IP and timestamp for security monitoring
Successful and failed database operations both logged (not just failures)
Rate limit rejections logged with IP for abuse detection
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current logging is inconsistent — some operations log success, some log nothing, some log only failures.

userStories.title: Accessibility improvements for PaywallView and toast
userStories.description: As a user with VoiceOver, I want the paywall pricing and toast notifications to be clearly announced so I can use the full app experience.
acceptanceCriteria: PaywallView savings badge accessibility label dynamically matches the computed savingsBadge value
Toast view uses accessibilityLabel that avoids redundant announcements (remove duplicate 'Logged!' text)
Toast auto-posts UIAccessibility.post(notification: .announcement) when it appears for VoiceOver users
SF Symbol picker grid in AddTrackerView has an accessibility label on the grid container
CancellationView stat items have explicit accessibilityLabel on each card
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Several accessibility labels are hardcoded or redundant, causing confusing VoiceOver experience.

userStories.title: User ID caching in SupabaseService
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the internal user ID cached after first lookup so every sync operation doesn't query the users table.
acceptanceCriteria: SupabaseService caches currentUserId in a private property after first successful lookup
Cache is cleared on sign out and on auth state change
Subsequent sync calls use the cached value instead of querying the database
Cache invalidation happens automatically if the database query returns a different user ID
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Currently queries users table on every single sync operation — wasteful and slow.

userStories.title: Graceful handling of 64-notification limit
userStories.description: As a user with many trackers, I want to know when some of my reminders won't fire so I can prioritize which items get notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: NotificationService tracks how many items were skipped due to the 64-item limit
If items were skipped, a local notification is scheduled as the 64th slot: 'You have X trackers without reminders. Open Last Logged to review.'
Settings screen shows a warning banner when notification count exceeds 64
Warning suggests upgrading to premium for the server-side reminder digest (which has no limit)
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Currently 36+ trackers silently lose notifications with no user awareness.

userStories.title: Data retention policy and database cleanup
userStories.description: As a developer, I need automated cleanup of old soft-deleted records and optional archival so the database doesn't grow unbounded.
acceptanceCriteria: New edge function endpoint POST /cleanup-old-data (protected by cron secret)
Permanently deletes soft-deleted completion_logs older than 90 days
Permanently deletes archived tracker_items with no completion_logs newer than 180 days
Cron job added for weekly execution (Sunday 3 AM)
Cleanup stats logged with structured logging
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Database will grow indefinitely without cleanup. Important for long-term operational health.

userStories.title: Timestamp-based sync conflict detection
userStories.description: As a user, I want my local edits preserved when they conflict with server data so I don't silently lose changes made offline.
acceptanceCriteria: TrackerItem model gains an updatedAt field (Date) that is set on every local mutation
SupabaseService pull method compares local updatedAt with remote updated_at before overwriting
If local updatedAt is newer than remote updated_at, local version is kept and marked as .pending for next push
If remote is newer, remote version overwrites local
Conflict events tracked in AnalyticsService for monitoring
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current pull blindly overwrites local data regardless of timestamps.

userStories.title: Separate user_devices table for multi-device push notifications
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a proper device tokens table so users with multiple devices all receive push notifications.
acceptanceCriteria: New SQL migration creates user_devices table: id, user_id, device_token, device_name, platform, last_seen_at, created_at
RLS policy: users can manage their own device entries
iOS app registers device token with Supabase on each app launch (upsert by device_token)
reminder-digest.ts queries user_devices instead of users.device_token
Stale device tokens (last_seen_at > 90 days) are excluded from push sends
Typecheck passes
userStories.notes: Current single device_token on users table only supports one device per user.
